On this page

Response families ​

Specify the sampling distribution beside each response and use formulas for any of its parameters. Links are explicit: log(sigma) ~ 1 + x declares a positive scale, while sigma ~ 1 + x declares an unconstrained predictor.

Support and parameters ​

Choose support first, then a parameterization whose priors you can interpret. The terms reference lists every mapped constructor and the supported compositions.

ResponseFamily examplesParametersCommon explicit link
RealNormal(mu, sigma), LocationScale(mu, sigma, TDist(nu))Location, scale; degrees of freedomIdentity for mu, log for scale
PositiveGamma(shape, scale), InverseGaussian(mu, lambda)Shape/scale or mean/concentrationLog
ProbabilityBeta(a, b)Two positive shapesLog on shapes, or transform mean and precision
Binary/trialsBernoulliLogit(eta), BinomialLogit(n, eta)Log odds; trials are dataIdentity on the log odds
CountPoisson(lambda), NegativeBinomial2(mu, phi)Rate or mean/precisionLog
Unordered categoryCategoricalLogit(eta2, eta3, ...)Log odds against the first levelIdentity on each log odds
Ordered categoryOrdinal(Cumulative(), ProbitLink(), eta)Predictor and inferred thresholdsLink supplied by the tag
Ordered category, thresholds givenOrdinal(Cumulative(), ProbitLink(), eta, cuts)Predictor and the model's threshold vector (per group in a @plate cell)Response holds codes 1:(length(cuts) + 1)
DirectionCircularVonMises(mu, kappa)Direction and concentrationIdentity for direction, log for concentration
Joint real vectorMvNormalCholesky([mu1, mu2], L)Mean vector, covariance factorIdentity for means

Julia's Exponential and Gamma arguments are scales. BRM converts them to Stan's rate convention when emitting Stan. NormalCanon(eta, lambda) uses precision, NegativeBinomial2(mu, phi) has variance mu + mu^2 / phi, and the scale in a Student-t model is not its standard deviation.

This model uses one covariate in a real-valued measurement and a positive waiting time. Each response has its own distributional predictors.

julia
model = (@brm begin
    mu ~ 1 + x
    log(sigma) ~ 1
    log(wait_mean) ~ 1 + x
    y ~ Normal(mu, sigma)
    waiting ~ InverseGaussian(wait_mean, concentration)

    effect(mu, :) ~ Normal(0, 1)
    effect(sigma, Intercept) ~ Normal(-1, 0.5)
    effect(wait_mean, :) ~ Normal(0, 0.5)
    concentration ~ Exponential(1)
end)((; x=[-1., 0., 1.], y=[-0.2, 0.4, 0.8], waiting=[0.5, 0.9, 1.8]))

julia
"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

"""
Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
`beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
"""
brm_joint_population_effects(X, ncoef, ntargets, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

begin
    X_Intercept_x = hcat(ones(length(x)), x)
    pop_Intercept_x ~ brm_joint_population_effects(X_Intercept_x, 2, 2, 0.0, hcat([1.0, 1.0], [0.5, 0.5]))
    pop_mu = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    mu = pop_mu
    sigma_Intercept ~ Normal(-1.0, 0.5)
    log_sigma = sigma_Intercept
    sigma = exp.(log_sigma)
    pop_log_wait_mean = pop_Intercept_x[:, 2]
    log_wait_mean = pop_log_wait_mean
    wait_mean = exp.(log_wait_mean)
    concentration ~ Exponential(1.0)
    y .~ Normal.(mu, exp.(log_sigma))
    waiting .~ InverseGaussian.(exp.(log_wait_mean), concentration)
end

functions {
// Form a matrix by concatenating the supplied columns in order.
matrix hcat(
    vector x,
    vector y
) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    if (dims(y)[1] != n) reject("hcat: dim mismatch — `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `x` dim 1. `n` sizes: `x` dim 1 (= ", dims(x)[1], "), `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ").");
    return append_col(x, y);
}
// Form a matrix by concatenating the supplied columns in order.
matrix hcat(vector x) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    return to_matrix(x, n, 1);
}
// Return one normal log probability per design row with mean alpha + X[i, :]*beta.
vector normal_id_glm_lpdfs(
    vector y,
    matrix X,
    real alpha,
    vector beta,
    vector sigma
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(X)[1] != n) reject("normal_id_glm_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = normal_lpdf(y[i] | (alpha + (X[i, :] * beta)), sigma);
    }
    return rv;
}
// Draw one normal response per design row with mean alpha + X*beta; an empty design gives an empty result.
vector normal_id_glm_vector_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    matrix X,
    real alpha,
    vector beta,
    vector sigma
) {
    int m = anontok__1;
    if (dims(X)[1] != m) reject("normal_id_glm_rng: dim mismatch — `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ") does not match `m` (= ", m, "), inferred from `anontok__1` dim 1. `m` sizes: `anontok__1` dim 1 (= ", anontok__1, "), `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ").");
    if((m == 0)) {
        vector[m] rv;
        return rv;
    } else {
        return normal_id_glm_rng(X, alpha, beta, sigma);
    }
}
// Draw one normal response per design row with mean alpha + X*beta; an empty design gives an empty result.
vector normal_id_glm_rng(
    matrix X,
    real alpha,
    vector beta,
    vector sigma
) {
    int m = dims(X)[1];
    if((m == 0)) {
        vector[m] rv;
        return rv;
    } else {
        return to_vector(normal_rng((rep_vector(alpha, m) + (X * beta)), sigma));
    }
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    real lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ").");
    return brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(y | mu, rep_vector(lambda, n));
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    vector lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    if (dims(lambda)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf: dim mismatch — `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    real rv = 0.0;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv += brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(y[i] | mu[i], lambda[i]);
    }
    return rv;
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(
    real y,
    real mu,
    real lambda
) {
    if((mu <= 0.0)) {
        return negative_infinity();
    } else {
        if((lambda <= 0.0)) {
            return negative_infinity();
        } else {
            if((y <= 0.0)) {
                return negative_infinity();
            } else {
                return (
                    (
                        (log(lambda) - (1.8378770664093456 + (3.0 * log(y)))) -
                        ((lambda * (y - mu) * (y - mu)) / (mu * mu * y))
                    ) /
                    2.0
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
vector brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    real lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ").");
    return brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(y, mu, rep_vector(lambda, n));
}
vector brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    vector lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    if (dims(lambda)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(y[i] | mu[i], lambda[i]);
    }
    return rv;
}
vector brm_inverse_gaussian_vector_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    vector mu,
    real lambda
) {
    int n = anontok__1;
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_rng: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `anontok__1` dim 1. `n` sizes: `anontok__1` dim 1 (= ", anontok__1, "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = brm_inverse_gaussian_rng(mu[i], lambda);
    }
    return rv;
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_rng(
    real mu,
    real lambda
) {
    if((mu <= 0.0)) {
        reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_rng: mu must be strictly positive");
        return 0.0;
    } else {
        if((lambda <= 0.0)) {
            reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_rng: lambda must be strictly positive");
            return 0.0;
        } else {
            real z = normal_rng(0.0, 1.0);
            real v = (z * z);
            real w = (mu * v);
            real x = (mu + ((mu / (2.0 * lambda)) * (w - sqrt((w * ((4.0 * lambda) + w))))));
            real u = uniform_rng(0.0, 1.0);
            if((u < (mu / (mu + x)))) {
                return x;
            } else {
                return ((mu * mu) / x);
            }
        }
    }
}
}
data {
    int x_n;
    vector[x_n] x;
    int y_n;
    vector[y_n] y;
    int waiting_n;
    vector[waiting_n] waiting;
}
transformed data {
    matrix[x_n, 2] X_mu = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(x)), x);
    int pop_mu_n_covariates = 2;
    matrix[num_elements(y), 1] X_log_sigma = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(y)));
    int pop_log_sigma_n_covariates = 1;
    matrix[x_n, 2] X_log_wait_mean = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(x)), x);
    int pop_log_wait_mean_n_covariates = 2;
}
parameters {
    vector[pop_mu_n_covariates] pop_mu_beta_pop;
    vector[pop_log_sigma_n_covariates] pop_log_sigma_beta_pop;
    vector[pop_log_wait_mean_n_covariates] pop_log_wait_mean_beta_pop;
    real<lower=0.0> concentration;
}
transformed parameters {
    vector[pop_mu_n_covariates] pop_mu = pop_mu_beta_pop;
    vector[num_elements(y)] pop_log_sigma = (X_log_sigma * pop_log_sigma_beta_pop);
    vector[num_elements(y)] log_sigma = pop_log_sigma;
    vector[num_elements(y)] sigma = exp(log_sigma);
    vector[x_n] pop_log_wait_mean = (X_log_wait_mean * pop_log_wait_mean_beta_pop);
    vector[x_n] log_wait_mean = pop_log_wait_mean;
    vector[x_n] wait_mean = exp(log_wait_mean);
}
model {
    pop_mu_beta_pop ~ normal([0, 0]', [1, 1]');
    pop_log_sigma_beta_pop ~ normal([-1]', [0.5]');
    pop_log_wait_mean_beta_pop ~ normal([0, 0]', [0.5, 0.5]');
    y ~ normal_id_glm(X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma);
    concentration ~ exponential((1.0 ./ 1));
    waiting ~ brm_inverse_gaussian(wait_mean, concentration);
}
generated quantities {
    vector[x_n] y_likelihood = normal_id_glm_lpdfs(y, X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma);
    vector[x_n] y_gen = normal_id_glm_vector_rng(y_n, X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma);
    vector[x_n] mu = (X_mu * pop_mu);
    vector[x_n] waiting_likelihood = brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(waiting, wait_mean, concentration);
    vector[x_n] waiting_gen = brm_inverse_gaussian_vector_rng(waiting_n, wait_mean, concentration);
}

"""Generated by ReactiveKernelsPPL.jax_source from a built @rkppl program; do not edit.

Data: X_Intercept_x, waiting, x, y.

Model documentation:

- `pop_Intercept_x`: Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

  Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
  `beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
  linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy.special as ssp
from typing import Any

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import jax.scipy.linalg
import jax.scipy.special as jsp
from jax.typing import ArrayLike

jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)

DIMENSION = 6
PARAMETERS = {"sigma_Intercept": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "concentration": {"start": 1, "stop": 2, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop": {"start": 2, "stop": 6, "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, 2)}}
DATA = {"X_Intercept_x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "waiting": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "y": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}}
INPUTS = ("unconstrained", "X_Intercept_x", "y", "waiting")
PREPARED = {"X_Intercept_x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "y": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "waiting": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}}
UNTRANSLATED = {}


def brm_joint_population_effects_density(
    unconstrained: ArrayLike,
    *,
    outputs: tuple[str, ...],
) -> dict:
    """Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

    Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
    `beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
    linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
    """
    results = {}
    if any(name in outputs for name in ("ppl_arrflat_beta_pop", "ppl_prior_beta_pop", "ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop")):
        ppl_arrflat_beta_pop = unconstrained[2:6]
    if any(name in outputs for name in ("ppl_prior_beta_pop", "ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop")):
        def _array_prior_cells() -> jax.Array:
            """Compute `_array_prior_cells` from its authored source."""
            if not (jnp.concatenate([jnp.stack([1.0, 1.0])[:, None], jnp.stack([0.5, 0.5])[:, None]], axis=1).shape == (2, 2)):
                raise ValueError("_array_prior_cells_mismatch threw")
            return jnp.ravel(jnp.concatenate([jnp.stack([1.0, 1.0])[:, None], jnp.stack([0.5, 0.5])[:, None]], axis=1), order="F")
        array_prior_cells = _array_prior_cells()
        ppl_parg_beta_pop_2 = array_prior_cells
        def ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop_cell(beta_pop, scale):
            scale_binding = 1.0 * scale
            log_scale = jnp.log(scale_binding)
            standardized = (beta_pop - 0.0) / jnp.where(jnp.logical_and(scale_binding == 0, beta_pop == 0.0), 1.0, scale_binding)
            standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            logpdf = standard_logpdf - jnp.where(jnp.logical_and(scale_binding == 0, beta_pop != 0.0), 0.0, log_scale)
            return logpdf
        ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop = (jnp.zeros(ppl_arrflat_beta_pop.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in ppl_arrflat_beta_pop.shape[:1] and ppl_parg_beta_pop_2.shape[:1] == ppl_arrflat_beta_pop.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop_cell, in_axes=(0, 0))(ppl_arrflat_beta_pop, ppl_parg_beta_pop_2))
    if any(name in outputs for name in ("ppl_prior_beta_pop",)):
        ppl_prior_beta_pop = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop)
    if "ppl_arrflat_beta_pop" in outputs:
        results["ppl_arrflat_beta_pop"] = ppl_arrflat_beta_pop
    if "ppl_prior_beta_pop" in outputs:
        results["ppl_prior_beta_pop"] = ppl_prior_beta_pop
    if "ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop" in outputs:
        results["ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop"] = ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop
    return results


def brm_joint_population_effects(
    X: ArrayLike,
    beta_pop: ArrayLike,
    *,
    outputs: tuple[str, ...],
) -> dict:
    """Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

    Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
    `beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
    linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
    """
    results = {}
    if any(name in outputs for name in ("value",)):
        value = X @ beta_pop
    if "value" in outputs:
        results["value"] = value
    return results


def prepare_data(X_Intercept_x: ArrayLike, waiting: ArrayLike, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The functions' data inputs, computed from the raw data once per dataset.

    Pass the data by the names the model reads them; a list of arrays is a ragged
    column. Call the other functions with the result: `f(u, **prepared)`.
    """
    X_Intercept_x = np.asarray(X_Intercept_x, dtype=np.float64)
    waiting = np.asarray(waiting, dtype=np.float64)
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
    return {"X_Intercept_x": np.asarray(X_Intercept_x, dtype=np.float64), "y": np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64), "waiting": np.asarray(waiting, dtype=np.float64)}


def model(_entry: str, unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> Any:
    """Shared model computation. The generated entry wrappers select a static output."""
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    waiting = prepared["waiting"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    waiting = jnp.asarray(waiting)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior", "log_likelihood", "constrain"):
        sigma_Intercept = unconstrained[0]
        u_argument = unconstrained[1]
        constrain_2 = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_likelihood"):
        rkppl_arg_1 = jnp.exp(sigma_Intercept)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior"):
        ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_log_scale = np.log(0.5)
        ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_standardized = (sigma_Intercept - -1.0) / jnp.where((sigma_Intercept == -1.0 if 0.5 == 0 else False), 1.0, 0.5)
        ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_standardized ** 2
        logpdf = ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_standard_logpdf - jnp.where((sigma_Intercept != -1.0 if 0.5 == 0 else False), 0.0, ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_log_scale)
        ppl_prior_concentration_log_scale = np.log(1.0)
        logpdf_2 = jax.lax.cond(constrain_2 < 0, lambda: -jnp.inf, lambda: -ppl_prior_concentration_log_scale - constrain_2 / 1.0)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_jacobian"):
        u_argument_2 = unconstrained[1]

Counts and extra zeros ​

HurdlePoisson(lambda, p_zero) assigns probability p_zero to zero and uses a zero-truncated Poisson for positive counts. With ZeroInflatedPoisson(lambda, zi), the ordinary Poisson component can also produce zeros. These probabilities therefore have different meanings.

"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

"""
Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
`beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
"""
brm_joint_population_effects(X, ncoef, ntargets, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

begin
    X_Intercept_x = hcat(ones(length(x)), x)
    pop_Intercept_x ~ brm_joint_population_effects(X_Intercept_x, 2, 2, 0.0, hcat([0.5, 0.5], [1.0, 1.0]))
    pop_log_lambda = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    log_lambda = pop_log_lambda
    lambda = exp.(log_lambda)
    p_zero_Intercept ~ Normal(0.0, 1.0)
    logit_p_zero = p_zero_Intercept
    p_zero = logistic.(logit_p_zero)
    pop_eta = pop_Intercept_x[:, 2]
    eta = pop_eta
    count .~ HurdlePoisson.(lambda, p_zero)
    successes .~ BinomialLogit.(trials, eta)
end

        def ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop_cell(beta_pop, scale):
            scale_binding = 1.0 * scale
            log_scale = jnp.log(scale_binding)
            standardized = (beta_pop - 0.0) / jnp.where(jnp.logical_and(scale_binding == 0, beta_pop == 0.0), 1.0, scale_binding)
            standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            logpdf = standard_logpdf - jnp.where(jnp.logical_and(scale_binding == 0, beta_pop != 0.0), 0.0, log_scale)
            return logpdf
        ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop = (jnp.zeros(ppl_arrflat_beta_pop.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in ppl_arrflat_beta_pop.shape[:1] and ppl_parg_beta_pop_2.shape[:1] == ppl_arrflat_beta_pop.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop_cell, in_axes=(0, 0))(ppl_arrflat_beta_pop, ppl_parg_beta_pop_2))
    if any(name in outputs for name in ("ppl_prior_beta_pop",)):
        ppl_prior_beta_pop = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop)
    if "ppl_arrflat_beta_pop" in outputs:
        results["ppl_arrflat_beta_pop"] = ppl_arrflat_beta_pop
    if "ppl_prior_beta_pop" in outputs:
        results["ppl_prior_beta_pop"] = ppl_prior_beta_pop
    if "ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop" in outputs:
        results["ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop"] = ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop
    return results


def brm_joint_population_effects(
    X: ArrayLike,
    beta_pop: ArrayLike,
    *,
    outputs: tuple[str, ...],
) -> dict:
    """Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

    Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
    `beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
    linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
    """
    results = {}
    if any(name in outputs for name in ("value",)):
        value = X @ beta_pop
    if "value" in outputs:
        results["value"] = value
    return results


def _integer_observation(x: ArrayLike, active: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """Compute `_integer_observation` from its authored source."""
    return True


@jax.custom_jvp
def _loggamma(x1):
    return jsp.gammaln(x1)


def _loggamma_partials_1(x1):
    return (jsp.gammaln(x1), jsp.digamma(x1))


def _loggamma_jvp(primals, tangents):
    active = tuple(not isinstance(t, jax.custom_derivatives.SymbolicZero) for t in tangents)
    mask = sum((1 << i) for i, a in enumerate(active) if a)
    if mask == 0:
        value = _loggamma(*primals)
        return value, jnp.zeros_like(value)
    if mask == 1:
        values = _loggamma_partials_1(*primals)
        return values[0], values[1] * tangents[0]
_loggamma.defjvp(_loggamma_jvp, symbolic_zeros=True)


def prepare_data(X_Intercept_x: ArrayLike, count: ArrayLike, successes: ArrayLike, trials: ArrayLike, x: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The functions' data inputs, computed from the raw data once per dataset.

    Pass the data by the names the model reads them; a list of arrays is a ragged
    column. Call the other functions with the result: `f(u, **prepared)`.
    """
    X_Intercept_x = np.asarray(X_Intercept_x, dtype=np.float64)
    count = np.asarray(count, dtype=np.int64)
    successes = np.asarray(successes, dtype=np.int64)
    trials = np.asarray(trials, dtype=np.int64)
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    def cell(successes_2, trials_2):
        if (successes_2 > 0) & (successes_2 < trials_2):
            value_2 = ssp.gammaln(trials_2 + 1.0)
            value_3 = ssp.gammaln(successes_2 + 1.0)
            value_4 = ssp.gammaln(trials_2 - successes_2 + 1.0)
            value = value_2 - value_3 - value_4
        else:
            value = 0.0
        lognormalizer = value
        return lognormalizer
    ppl_pwn_successes_resp = np.asarray([cell(element, element_2) for element, element_2 in zip(successes, trials)], dtype=np.float64)
    ppl_lnorm_successes_resp = np.sum(ppl_pwn_successes_resp)
    def lane_conditions(lane_input_1):
        return (bool(lane_input_1 == 0),)
    lane_conditions_2 = np.asarray([lane_conditions(entry) for entry in count], dtype=bool).reshape((-1, 1))
    lanes = np.flatnonzero(lane_conditions_2[:, 0])
    lanes_2 = np.flatnonzero(~lane_conditions_2[:, 0])
    ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1 = lanes
    ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2 = lanes_2
    ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order = np.argsort(np.concatenate((lanes, lanes_2,)), kind="stable")
    return {"X_Intercept_x": np.asarray(X_Intercept_x, dtype=np.float64), "count": np.asarray(count, dtype=np.int64), "_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1": np.asarray(ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1, dtype=np.int64), "_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2": np.asarray(ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2, dtype=np.int64), "_ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order": np.asarray(ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order, dtype=np.int64), "successes": np.asarray(successes, dtype=np.int64), "trials": np.asarray(trials, dtype=np.int64), "_ppl_lnorm_successes_resp": ppl_lnorm_successes_resp}


def model(_entry: str, unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> Any:
    """Shared model computation. The generated entry wrappers select a static output."""
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    count = prepared["count"]
    _ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1 = prepared["_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1"]
    _ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2 = prepared["_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2"]
    _ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order = prepared["_ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order"]
    successes = prepared["successes"]
    trials = prepared["trials"]
    _ppl_lnorm_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_lnorm_successes_resp"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    count = jnp.asarray(count)
    _ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1 = jnp.asarray(_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1)
    _ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2 = jnp.asarray(_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2)
    _ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order = jnp.asarray(_ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order)
    successes = jnp.asarray(successes)
    trials = jnp.asarray(trials)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior", "log_likelihood", "constrain"):
        p_zero_Intercept = unconstrained[0]
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_likelihood"):
        p_zero = jax.nn.sigmoid(p_zero_Intercept)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior"):
        ppl_prior_p_zero_Intercept_log_scale = np.log(1.0)
        ppl_prior_p_zero_Intercept_standardized = (p_zero_Intercept - 0.0) / jnp.where((p_zero_Intercept == 0.0 if 1.0 == 0 else False), 1.0, 1.0)
        ppl_prior_p_zero_Intercept_standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * ppl_prior_p_zero_Intercept_standardized ** 2
        logpdf = ppl_prior_p_zero_Intercept_standard_logpdf - jnp.where((p_zero_Intercept != 0.0 if 1.0 == 0 else False), 0.0, ppl_prior_p_zero_Intercept_log_scale)
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_jacobian"):
        log_jacobian_2 = 0.0
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior", "log_likelihood", "constrain"):
        pop_Intercept_x = brm_joint_population_effects_density(
            unconstrained=(unconstrained if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior", "log_likelihood", "constrain") else None),
            outputs=tuple(
                name for name, needed in (
                    ("ppl_arrflat_beta_pop", ("log_density", "log_prior", "log_likelihood", "constrain")),
                    ("ppl_prior_beta_pop", ("log_density", "log_prior")),
                    ("ppl_pw_prior_beta_pop", ("log_density", "log_prior")),
                )
                if _entry in needed
            ),
        )
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_likelihood", "constrain"):
        pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(pop_Intercept_x["ppl_arrflat_beta_pop"], (2, 2), order="F")
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_prior"):
        prior = logpdf + pop_Intercept_x["ppl_prior_beta_pop"]
    if _entry in ("log_density", "log_likelihood"):
        pop_Intercept_x_2 = brm_joint_population_effects(
            X=(X_Intercept_x if _entry in ("log_density", "log_likelihood") else None),
            beta_pop=(pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop if _entry in ("log_density", "log_likelihood") else None),
            outputs=tuple(
                name for name, needed in (
                    ("value", ("log_density", "log_likelihood")),
                )
                if _entry in needed
            ),
        )
        pop_log_lambda = pop_Intercept_x_2["value"][:, 0]
        lambda_ = jnp.exp(pop_log_lambda)
        pop_eta = pop_Intercept_x_2["value"][:, 1]
        lane_entries = jnp.asarray(count)[_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1]
        lane_entries_2 = jnp.asarray(lambda_)[_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_1]
        def ppl_pw_count_resp_cell(count_2, lambda__2, p_zero_2):
            ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(lambda__2 > 0, (p_zero_2 >= 0) & (p_zero_2 <= 1)), lambda: jnp.log(p_zero_2), lambda: -jnp.inf)
            return ppl_density
        plate_part = (jnp.zeros(lane_entries.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in lane_entries.shape[:1] and lane_entries_2.shape[:1] == lane_entries.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(ppl_pw_count_resp_cell, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(lane_entries, lane_entries_2, p_zero))
        lane_entries_3 = jnp.asarray(count)[_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2]
        lane_entries_4 = jnp.asarray(lambda_)[_ppl_pw_count_resp_lanes_2]
        def ppl_pw_count_resp_cell_2(count_2, lambda__2, p_zero_2):
            def then_arm_2():
                integer_observation = _integer_observation(count_2, jnp.logical_and(lambda__2 > 0, (p_zero_2 >= 0) & (p_zero_2 <= 1)))
                def then_arm():
                    def else_arm():
                        value = _loggamma(count_2 + 1.0)
                        return count_2 * jnp.log(lambda__2) - lambda__2 - value
                    return jax.lax.cond(count_2 == 0, lambda: -lambda__2, else_arm)
                return jnp.log1p(-p_zero_2) + jax.lax.cond((count_2 >= 0 if integer_observation else False), then_arm, lambda: -jnp.inf) - jnp.log(-jnp.expm1(-lambda__2))
            ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(lambda__2 > 0, (p_zero_2 >= 0) & (p_zero_2 <= 1)), then_arm_2, lambda: -jnp.inf)
            return ppl_density
        plate_part_2 = (jnp.zeros(lane_entries_3.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in lane_entries_3.shape[:1] and lane_entries_4.shape[:1] == lane_entries_3.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(ppl_pw_count_resp_cell_2, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(lane_entries_3, lane_entries_4, p_zero))
        ppl_pw_count_resp = jnp.concatenate((plate_part, plate_part_2,))[_ppl_pw_count_resp_lane_order]
        ppl_lik_count_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_count_resp)
        def ppl_pwk_successes_resp_cell(successes_2, eta, trials_2):
            def then_arm_2():
                def else_arm_4():
                    def else_arm_3():
                        def else_arm_2():
                            def then_arm():
                                l1pe = jax.nn.softplus(-eta)
                                return -successes_2 * l1pe - (trials_2 - successes_2) * (l1pe + eta)
                            def else_arm():
                                l1pe_2 = jax.nn.softplus(eta)
                                return -successes_2 * (l1pe_2 - eta) - (trials_2 - successes_2) * l1pe_2
                            return jax.lax.cond(eta >= 0, then_arm, else_arm)
                        return jax.lax.cond(successes_2 == trials_2, lambda: -trials_2 * jax.nn.softplus(-eta), else_arm_2)
                    return jax.lax.cond(successes_2 == 0, lambda: -trials_2 * jax.nn.softplus(eta), else_arm_3)
                return jax.lax.cond(trials_2 == 0, lambda: 0.0, else_arm_4)
            logkernel_lp = jax.lax.cond((successes_2 >= 0) & (successes_2 <= trials_2), then_arm_2, lambda: -jnp.inf)
            return logkernel_lp
        ppl_pwk_successes_resp = (jnp.zeros(successes.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in successes.shape[:1] and pop_eta.shape[:1] == successes.shape[:1] and trials.shape[:1] == successes.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(ppl_pwk_successes_resp_cell, in_axes=(0, 0, 0))(successes, pop_eta, trials))
        ppl_kernel_successes_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pwk_successes_resp)
        ppl_lik_successes_resp = ppl_kernel_successes_resp + _ppl_lnorm_successes_resp
        likelihood = ppl_lik_count_resp + ppl_lik_successes_resp
    if _entry in ("log_density",):
        posterior = prior + likelihood + log_jacobian_2
    if _entry == "log_density":
        if not (unconstrained.size == 5):
            raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return jnp.asarray(posterior, dtype=jnp.float64)
    if _entry == "log_prior":
        if not (unconstrained.size == 5):
            raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return jnp.asarray(prior, dtype=jnp.float64)
    if _entry == "log_likelihood":
        if not (unconstrained.size == 5):
            raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return jnp.asarray(likelihood, dtype=jnp.float64)
    if _entry == "log_jacobian":
        return jnp.asarray(log_jacobian_2, dtype=jnp.float64)
    if _entry == "constrain":
        if not (unconstrained.size == 5):
            raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return {"p_zero_Intercept": jnp.asarray(p_zero_Intercept, dtype=jnp.float64), "pop_Intercept_x": {"beta_pop": jnp.asarray(pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop)}}


def log_density(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log density a sampler targets at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`.

    The sum of `log_prior`, `log_likelihood` and `log_jacobian`.
    """
    return model("log_density", unconstrained, **prepared)


def log_prior(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log prior density of the constrained parameters at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    return model("log_prior", unconstrained, **prepared)


def log_likelihood(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log likelihood of the observations at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    return model("log_likelihood", unconstrained, **prepared)


def log_jacobian(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log Jacobian of the constraining transforms at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    return model("log_jacobian", unconstrained, **prepared)


def constrain(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The constrained value of each parameter, and of each requested value, at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`. Returns a dict, a submodel's values nested under its name (a submodel call's own value under `return` there):

    - `p_zero_Intercept`
    - `pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop`
    """
    return model("constrain", unconstrained, **prepared)


def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return 5


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"p_zero_Intercept": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop": {"start": 1, "stop": 5, "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, 2)}}

Categories and thresholds ​

A nested formula gives CategoricalLogit its own coefficients for each non-reference level. Plain vectors use sorted unique levels; a categorical vector uses its declared level order. The first level has logit zero. Fitted levels remain fixed during replay. effect(choice, x) ~ Normal(0, s) addresses the nested formula's coefficients through the response: it sets x's coefficient in every non-reference level. When the formula is an intercept and continuous data columns, as below, it is one predictor with a coefficient column per non-reference level, and the number of levels is data: 3 and 4 levels build one program on both backends. Any other term, such as a factor column or group-level effects, gives one predictor per non-reference level, and there the number of levels sets the number of predictors. On the ReactiveKernels backend the level labels are data, so responses that differ only in their labels share one program.

An ordinal model supplies its location through thresholds, so its common predictor has no intercept. Cumulative() has ordered thresholds; StoppingRatio() has separate stage intercepts. Both accept LogitLink(), ProbitLink() or CloglogLink().

"""
Each value's position (1-based) in `level_values`: the level codes of a grouping or factor.
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_prepared_indices(values, level_values) = begin
            indices = ReactiveKernels.plate(values) do value
                    Int(findfirst(isequal(value), level_values))
                end
            return indices

"""
Class-block population effects: one coefficient per design column and non-reference class.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:nclass] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns `X * beta_pop`, one
linear predictor column per non-reference class. `ncoef` is the number of
columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per design column, shared by that column's classes.
"""
brm_class_population_effects(X, ncoef, nclass, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:nclass] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

functions {
// Form a matrix by concatenating the supplied columns in order.
matrix hcat(
    vector x,
    vector y
) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    if (dims(y)[1] != n) reject("hcat: dim mismatch — `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `x` dim 1. `n` sizes: `x` dim 1 (= ", dims(x)[1], "), `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ").");
    return append_col(x, y);
}
// Sum categorical log probabilities, using column i of eta as the logits for observation i.
real categorical_logit_lpmf(
    array[] int y,
    matrix eta
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(eta)[2] != n) reject("categorical_logit_lpmf: dim mismatch — `eta` dim 2 (= ", dims(eta)[2], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `eta` dim 2 (= ", dims(eta)[2], ").");
    real rv = 0.0;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv += categorical_logit_lpmf(y[i] | eta[:, i]);
    }
    return rv;
}
// Return one categorical log probability per observation, using its own column of logits.
vector categorical_logit_lpmfs(
    array[] int y,
    matrix eta
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(eta)[2] != n) reject("categorical_logit_lpmfs: dim mismatch — `eta` dim 2 (= ", dims(eta)[2], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `eta` dim 2 (= ", dims(eta)[2], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = categorical_logit_lpmf(y[i] | eta[:, i]);
    }
    return rv;
}
// Draw one category per column of logits.
array[] int categorical_logit_int_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    matrix eta
) {
    int n = anontok__1;
    if (dims(eta)[2] != n) reject("categorical_logit_rng: dim mismatch — `eta` dim 2 (= ", dims(eta)[2], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `anontok__1` dim 1. `n` sizes: `anontok__1` dim 1 (= ", anontok__1, "), `eta` dim 2 (= ", dims(eta)[2], ").");
    array[n] int rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = categorical_logit_rng(eta[:, i]);
    }

def _rk_order_key_np(x):
    # Julia's isless order of an array as sortable keys: a float is an integer
    # key, -0.0 before 0.0 and every NaN last, equal for values isequal treats

    # Julia's sort of a vector: ascending in isless order, equal values in
    # their order.
    x = np.asarray(x)
    return x[np.argsort(_rk_order_key_np(x), kind="stable")]
